name: euremotejobs-mcp
description: EU Remote Jobs (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: GET https://euremotejobs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings: the WP Job Manager job_listing post type through the WordPress REST API posts controller (arguments page, per_page <= 100, search = WordPress full-text search; the route's own schema is listed at that URL). location and remote are not sent (location is post meta / a region taxonomy, not a query argument). title and description are rendered HTML; company is meta._company_name, location meta._job_location, the apply link meta._application and salary meta._job_salary stay in raw.meta. Only published listings are returned; a page past the end answers 400 rest_post_invalid_page_number (upstream_error). This board stores location in the job_listing_region taxonomy (ids in raw.job_listing_region), so location is usually null.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings/<id> with the numeric post id from search; an unknown id answers 404 rest_post_invalid_id (invalid_input).
